messages.subject: modify and plot geological timescale
parts:
Dear Nick and members of the group,

I couldn't find the answer for this googling it or in the group, so: I'd like to know if there is a way to customize the axisPhylo plot to plot the pdf with a timescale divided at specific intervals such as from 5 to 5 Ma instead of the default 20 to 20 Ma. Moreover, is there any chance to plot a full geological timescale on the pdf plot (using the geoscalePhylo function in the geoscale package)?

Thanks so much for any contributions!


Best

Alex

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] modify and plot geological timescale
parts: Hi -- with the current function, there's no way to do this. But you could always copy the plot function, search the function code for the axisPhylo command, then replace that with e.g. a geoscalePhylo function.  Cheers! Nick
